extensionDescription.message: Summarize the current page in an AI web chat from the browser side panel.

statusExtracted.message: Page content extracted. Sending to AI...

statusFallback.message: Content extraction failed. Switched to URL mode.

summaryPrompt.message:
Summarize the uploaded page attachment concisely. Keep only the 3-5 most important points, stay under 300 words, and list 1-3 useful follow-up questions. Do not repeat the source text.
Respond in English.

urlSummaryPrompt.message:
Summarize the page at the link below concisely. Keep only the 3-5 most important points and list 1-3 useful follow-up questions.
Page title: $1
Page URL: $2

providerHelp.message: Kimi is the primary path; DeepSeek and Gemini are experimental.

maxPromptHelp.message: Longer prompts are truncated automatically. Default: 12000 characters.

defaultPromptHelp.message: Page content is attached as a file; write only the summary task here.

promptRestored.message: Default prompt restored. Save to apply.

notReady.message: $1 is not ready. Please try again.

attachmentNotReady.message: The AI page attachment is not ready. Sending stopped.

inputNotFilled.message: The AI page input did not show the prompt.

attachmentUnstable.message: The AI page attachment was not stable before submission. Sending stopped.

submitNotConfirmed.message: The AI page did not confirm submission; the prompt remains in the input.

attachmentNotConsumed.message: The prompt was submitted, but the attachment remains in the input.

noArticle.message: No extractable main content was found
